fieldValues.title: Canonical meaning and facets
fieldValues.summary: A repository declares one repository-owned set of presentations it commits to render and can produce reproducible, readable projections from canonical meaning; neither the presentations nor their projections becomes an authoritative store.
fieldValues.body:
## Capabilities

- Present Facets
- Work With Meaning

## Sources

- repo-path: docs/spec/srs-unified.md
- repo-path: rfcs/rfc-015-view-owned-ordering-declared-presentations.md

## Not Included

- A single required renderer, theme or layout-preservation promise
- Byte-identical rendering across independent implementations
